question: Who is famous for playing the percussion instrument Tabla?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Allah Rakha__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Allah Rakha** was a renowned tabla player known for his virtuosity and contribution to Indian classical music.
 
• He collaborated extensively with **sitar maestro Ravi Shankar**, bringing Indian classical music to international audiences.
 
• Allah Rakha played a significant role in popularizing the tabla as a solo instrument.
 
• He was the father of Zakir Hussain, another legendary tabla player.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Allah Rakha**: Internationally renowned tabla player, collaborated with Ravi Shankar, popularized tabla globally, father of Zakir Hussain.
 
• **Ayodhya Prasad**: Respected tabla player from Banaras Gharana, known within India, significant contributions to Indian classical music, less international recognition.
